name: Bleeding Hearts
source:
Caught in an accidental love triangle by Cupid, Stella has to make the academy’s biggest rivals, Edgar and Jensen, confess their love to each other by the end of Valentine’s Day. 

[From [url=https://team-cauldron.itch.io/bleeding-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
丘比特一时弄巧成拙，把斯特拉卷进了三角恋。她必须赶在情人节结束之前，让学院里最针锋相对的两个死对头埃德加和詹森互相告白。

［摘自[url=https://team-cauldron.itch.io/bleeding-hearts]itch.io[/url]］
